equations.title: Cycle-space dimension
equations.limit: Counts loops of actual edges in a chosen typed graph; does not measure Qi or actual pipes.

equations.title: Stepwise node balance
equations.limit: Only if quantities are in shared conserved units; information meaning does not automatically conserve.

equations.title: Weighted graph Hodge split
equations.equation: j=-W B phi+c; c in ker(B^T); W=diag(w_e)>0
equations.limit: Requires independently measured, typed edges, orientation and weights for real-world use.

equations.title: Pure gradient cannot sustain independent cycle flux
equations.equation: For c in ker(B^T): c^T W^-1 (-W B phi)=0
equations.limit: Weighted orthogonality, not claiming all networks lack cycle flow.

equations.title: No identification of hidden cycle from nodal differences
equations.equation: B^T(j+c)=B^T j for all c in ker(B^T)
equations.limit: Even perfect node-step records cannot determine unseen circulation without measured edge flow or stronger assumptions.

equations.title: Passive cycle-current relaxation vs active drive
equations.equation: c[n+1]=rho c[n]+a[n], 0<=rho<1; if a=0 then c[n] -> 0; if a constant then c*=a/(1-rho)
equations.limit: A driven cycle is conditional on active input/feedback; not proof of infinite or clinical Qi energy.

equations.title: Location-dependent modal forcing
equations.limit: If L unchanged, moving source changes modal excitation but not intrinsic L eigenvalues.

equations.title: Homogeneous ring has no privileged vertex
equations.equation: For cycle-rotation P: P^T L P=L; identical rotated inputs give rotated outputs under equivariant dynamics
equations.limit: DT-L cannot acquire unique physiological status from a symmetric ring alone; would require independent symmetry-breaking evidence.

equations.title: Split-port/collocated source-sink guard
equations.equation: J=j(e_input-e_output); if input==output at one vertex J=0; nonzero c in ker(B^T) remains possible on cycles
equations.limit: Zero net injection does NOT imply zero internal loop current. Separate physical pressure from information-model ports.

exact_graph_audit.meaning: cycle rank refers to semantic ontology edges, NOT meridian fluids
